findings.title: TypeScript coverage counts are missing fixture-level verification
findings.description: Task 20 checks that the Istanbul fixture parses and has version `0.1`, but not that its per-file `coverable_lines` and `covered_lines` match the report. Task 24 checks coverage-measurement behavior and the provider-limit text, but does not assert the Istanbul report’s line counts. This leaves Success Criterion 7’s present TypeScript coverage insufficiently verified; add a line-count assertion using the real fixture.

findings.title: Two tasks exceed the slice’s proportional scope
findings.description: The 30-task plan is unusually prescriptive for this slice. Tasks 18 and 29 require creating and removing a scratch Vitest project, capturing real reports, and running a ten-step live walkthrough across multiple repositories, then recording results in the design. Keep real-report fixtures as required by the technical criteria, but trim the walkthrough to the checks not already covered by focused tests; avoid requiring extensive implementation mechanics such as the specific capture project setup unless needed to exercise the parser.

findings.title: Core implementation and tests are generally sequenced together
findings.description: The plan pairs complexity, duplication, coverage parsing/freshness/measurement, and rendering with follow-up tests, and includes commit markers at working points. The later walkthrough and final validation follow implementation. No circular dependency is apparent.
